steps.name: expo-scaffold
steps.summary: Expo SDK 57 골격: package.json(name splito, main expo-router/entry, scripts lint/build/test/start, expo-dev-client, jest-expo·eslint-config-expo devDeps), app.json(name/slug/scheme 'splito', 템플릿 plugins), tsconfig.json(strict, @/*→./src/*, exclude supabase/functions·web), eslint.config.js(flat, eslint-config-expo/flat), jest.config.js(preset jest-expo), app/_layout.tsx(Stack), app/index.tsx('스플리토'), assets/(icon·splash·android·favicon·expo.icon); 템플릿 의존성(@expo/ui·expo-image·react-native-web 등)은 그대로 둠

steps.name: styling-tokens
